summary:
I have found the deadlock bug in `TransferService.java` which was caused by acquiring locks on accounts in the order they were passed as parameters. I fixed this by implementing a consistent locking order based on the account IDs (`compareTo`). To ensure thread safety, I also updated the `completedTransfers` and `failedTransfers` counters to use `AtomicInteger`. 

I then ran `/app/test.sh` and confirmed that all concurrent transfers now complete successfully without deadlocking.
